answer: The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. A bike-share membership history with ride logs works as the gate: rides logged under one membership across seasons. Each of 175 aliases needs its own ride logs, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the tide signal is public, the cedar check is automatic, and 175 aliases cost 175 times what one real agent costs, with the nadir trail open to all.
